meta.purpose: Define target-repository agent-surface seal families, representative samples, and Progressive HITL review prompts outside generator code.

required_markers: Treat this as context, not as permission to broaden the patch.

health_metrics: Use this bounded triage context before selecting a concrete edit target.
No direct edit target; first request a concrete target_file from a primary agent tool.

negative_probe_purposes.confidence_missing_target: Intentional fail-closed probe for a missing target file.
negative_probe_purposes.external_target_preflight_invalid: Intentional fail-closed probe for an invalid external target root.
negative_probe_purposes.patch_validation_missing_target: Intentional fail-closed probe for an ungrounded patch target.
negative_probe_purposes.patch_validation_negative: Intentional exact-payload applicability failure probe for patch validation.
negative_probe_purposes.watchdog_session_missing: Intentional no-active-session probe for watchdog packet behavior.

allowed_no_review_target_markers: No queued architecture/governance debt is available
Do not analyze or edit a repository until the target root is a real local directory
Do not invent a fix target from this clean queue
Do not edit from this summary alone.
manual_pack_selection_policy.purpose: Keep the Progressive HITL manual seal pack diverse enough to catch target/file/type-specific defects without dumping every reviewed sample. Selection is deterministic, but it prefers diversity over repeatedly showing the same package or target.

review_tracker_policy.purpose: Track target-repository agent packet family coverage, variants, and deferred debts so manual review does not circle over the same surfaces without a ledger.

manual_agent_review_evidence_policy.rule: Automated packet checks cannot claim manual review. packet_sha256 preserves exact packet provenance; review_semantics_sha256 binds review currentness to normalized decision semantics while retaining volatile field presence. reviewed_semantic_variants preserves separately reviewed, legitimate lifecycle semantics without overwriting prior evidence; an unseen semantic variant remains stale. Legacy evidence without a semantic fingerprint remains current only while its exact packet hash matches. Source-backed samples must name source paths and lines or explain why fail-closed behavior makes source comparison not applicable.

families.label: Primary fix queue
families.role: Choose the smallest concrete architecture/governance fix target.
manual_review_prompts: Does the packet name the exact target file before asking for a fix?
Does the action ask for the smallest safe patch instead of broad cleanup?
Does it include the violated rule and evidence in words an agent can act on?

families.label: Target inspection
families.role: Open exact target files and disambiguate symbols before editing.
manual_review_prompts: Can the agent open the target with analysis_root + target_file?
If the symbol is ambiguous, does the packet force target_ref/project narrowing before edits?
Does it avoid treating SAGE target_ref values as filesystem paths?

families.label: Impact and causality
families.role: Bound blast radius and upstream-cause checks without expanding scope by default.
manual_review_prompts: Does the packet bound direct/transitive impact instead of dumping the whole graph?
Does it tell the agent how to request deeper impact only when needed?
Does upstream evidence point to a plausible source-cause path?

families.label: Confidence and readiness
families.role: Estimate whether a target has enough fresh evidence for action without turning confidence into approval.
manual_review_prompts: Does the packet distinguish confidence from permission to edit or release?
Does it say what must be refreshed or inspected before a confidence decision?
Does it avoid hiding missing-target or stale-artifact uncertainty?

families.label: Test and patch validation
families.role: Tell the agent which tests to run and whether a patch is safe to apply.
manual_review_prompts: Does the packet say which validation command or test family matters?
Does patch validation fail closed when the target file is missing or unrelated?
Does it avoid treating a test PASS as architecture approval?

families.label: Merge review
families.role: Review variation/import candidates without granting mutation permission.
manual_review_prompts: Does the packet clearly say review-only and withhold mutation permission?
Does it name the candidate source/target surfaces enough for a reviewer to inspect them?
Does it separate merge readiness from automatic merge authorization?

families.label: Supporting context
families.role: Provide bounded context after a concrete edit target exists.
manual_review_prompts: Does the packet provide context only after a concrete target exists?
Does it avoid turning support context into a broad refactor mandate?
Does it keep dead-code/circular-dependency actions in review-before-delete mode?

families.label: Operator and ContextOS packets
families.role: Separate SAGE/operator status and actor-gateway conformance from target-repository coding instructions and mutation authority.
manual_review_prompts: Does the packet separate target-repository coding instructions from SAGE platform status?
Does it avoid leaking debug/release internals into the default target-agent projection?
Does it preserve operational next steps rather than raw artifact trivia?
Does proposal conformance stop at PROPOSED without implying authorization, validation or acceptance?

families.label: External target safety
families.role: Fail closed when a target root, active signal, or target file is missing.
manual_review_prompts: Does the packet fail closed when the external target root is invalid?
Does it forbid fallback to the SAGE workspace or stale unrelated artifacts?
Does it tell the agent what input must be corrected before continuing?
